name: THE ONE-STRIKE MAN
note: AN INTERACTION IDENTITY, NOT A SPRITE. He is the seated man in the brown coat at the near (left) end of the bar -- drawn and animated by nugget_bar1's band, which this file does not touch. Tyler, 2026-10-31: the OLD Nugget ships and the rebuild (nugget_candidate) is retired -- it moves, its problems can be fixed, and the rebuild's bar defects could not. Story-wise the two rooms carry the same twelve hotspots and two exits; what the rebuild had and the old room lacked was these two identities, so they move here. The sprite is a frame of pure transparency over him.
greetsWithBarkNote: Tyler, 2026-10-31: TALK TO opens with his bark for the current reputation, so the tree's first options answer something. Doc 07 writes no root line for him; this stages his own barks, it adds none.
walkToNote: floor_2 at the open end of the bar, beside him and facing him. DEKE VESSEL, when he is drawn, needs the bar's near end too (build contract: 'near end of the bar for A3'); in this plate that is the standing room in front of this man and the first stool, not his seat.
registrationNote: His head top in the old plate is y 360 at x 1205. zone 2 is 222 tall, so y 582 puts speakerHead at 360. The frame is cut to 155x222, so Ambient.npcAt's box is x 1161-1249, y 360-582: his head, shoulders and back down to the stool.
approachNote: 130 because the anchor is not his feet: walkTo (1095,640) is 124px from (1205,582), and the bark must fire on arrival.

sprite.note: ZERO ALPHA EVERYWHERE (tools/retrofit/nugget-identity-frames.py asserts it). The declared frame is the top 222 rows of the 155x263 sheet.

barksNote: Doc 07 §13's bark table, all nine states. THE STRIKE SHRINKS FROM A FIST TO A PEA ACROSS THEM AND NOTHING ANYWHERE MARKS IT -- that is his whole arc and it must stay unmarked. TWO TRANSFORMS, both recorded: the document's British "colour" is written "color" because the fiction is American and check-american-english enforces it (doc 07 §13 was corrected in the same commit, so the document and the content still read alike); and R_DEAD's internal direction, written "Found color in ’49." *(pause)* "Think I did.", loses the parenthetical because a bark is one string. No word is added or changed.
idNote: THE ID IS THE SPEAKER ID, AND THAT IS MECHANISM RATHER THAN CONVENTION. Renderer.speakerHead finds an ambient speaker by `each.id === this.speaker`, and the speaker is what the TREE declares -- so an ambient called nugget_card_sharp whose tree says `card_sharp` is never found, and doc 30 section 3.1's forbidden top-centre fallback fires for a man plainly on screen. It did: the first live proof of this pass drew "I am." over the chandelier. Every other speaking character in the game -- winnie, pie_woman, map_seller, letter_writer -- is named this way for the same reason, and the room-prefixed nugget_* ids belong to the ambients that never speak.
